name: What is the process for a custom framing project?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for a custom framing project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The custom framing process begins after site preparation and foundation work are complete. First, the floor system is laid out and built. Then, wall sections are assembled on the ground and tilted into place. Once walls are braced, the ceiling and roof framing follow, including rafters, trusses, and sheathing. Throughout this process, strict adherence to blueprints, local building codes, and safety standards is maintained. Inspections are conducted at various stages to ensure structural integrity and quality before moving on to subsequent construction phases.
acceptedAnswer.description: The custom framing process involves building floor systems, assembling and raising walls, and then constructing the ceiling and roof, all while adhering to blueprints and codes.
